property_summary: For any caller and any address before initialization, SetLogFile(_log) must make the contract route log messages to _log; after SetLogFile to a fresh logger, a Deposit must append a message to that logger (observable via History(0)), which the mutant violates because Log keeps its original address so the fresh logger records nothing.
change_summary: Remove the assignment so the LogFile address never changes, leaving Log at its original value even after SetLogFile is called.
